name: Shadow Resistant
body:
Your struggles against creatures from the Plane of Shadows gives you an added defense against such attacks.

Prerequisite: Must have been the target of a spell or spell-like ability with the shadow descriptor

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities with the shadow descriptor.
